units.source_text: > 目无体以万物之色为体

en.t: The eye has no body of its own; it takes the colors of all things as its body.

units.source_text: > > 耳无体以万物之声为体

en.t: The ear has no body of its own; it takes the sounds of all things as its body.

units.source_text: > > 鼻无体以万物之臭为体

en.t: The nose has no body of its own; it takes the smells of all things as its body.

units.source_text: > > 口无体以万物之味为体

en.t: The mouth has no body of its own; it takes the tastes of all things as its body.

units.source_text: > > 心无体以万物之感应是非为体

en.t: The mind has no body of its own; it takes its responses to all things and its judgments of right and wrong as its body.
